workflows.title: Daily Job Search Automation
workflows.description: Runs a structured job-search process based on target role criteria, focused on technical customer-facing SaaS and AI roles across Israel, the Netherlands, Portugal, and relevant Remote Europe / EMEA / global opportunities.
points: Targets Technical Solutions, Implementation, AI Implementation, Product Operations, Technical Account Management, Forward Deployed, AI Workflow / Automation, Customer Engineer, Professional Services, and Solutions Consulting roles.
Uses configurable role, company, location, remote-policy, salary-threshold, rejection-rule, and AI-evaluation criteria.
Outputs structured opportunities instead of an unfiltered list of links.

workflows.title: Company Source Refresh Automation
workflows.description: Runs separately from the daily job search and continuously improves the search universe by discovering relevant companies, career pages, ATS sources, and search keywords.
points: Adds high-confidence companies and keywords into the daily search logic.
Keeps medium and low-confidence sources as manual-verification suggestions.
Protects the main search flow from noisy source expansion.

workflows.title: Deduplication Logic
workflows.description: Prevents repeated opportunities from appearing as new by comparing each run against previous results and a local history layer.
points: Deduplicates by raw URL or direct apply link.
Deduplicates by company, normalized role title, and location.
Maintains a Dedup History so future runs can compare against previous results.

workflows.title: Excel / CSV Export
workflows.description: Generates structured reports designed to support review, prioritization, and future imports.
points: Exports sheets for Verified Apply Now, Needs Manual Verification, Companies to Monitor, Top 10 Apply First, Search Strategy, Summary, Already Seen / Not New, Dedup History, and Sources.
Supports a future CSV import and export workflow.
Keeps output reusable by later automation runs.

technicalHighlights: Built a structured AI workflow around repeatable job-search logic.
Designed automation prompts with clear role criteria, exclusion rules, deduplication requirements, and output format.
Created a two-layer automation strategy: daily job discovery and weekly company/source discovery.
Added safeguards so source-refresh updates only affect the main search when confidence is high.
Designed an Excel-based local history mechanism for deduplication.
Structured the output so it can be reused by future runs.

caseStudies.title: Enterprise Onboarding & Product Execution (InsurTech)
caseStudies.context: US insurance carrier spending $8M-$23M annually through a SaaS RTB platform requiring integration with 5-6 ecosystem partners (RTB + lead enhancement providers such as TransUnion and Jornaya).
caseStudies.action: Owned end-to-end onboarding (4-6 weeks): led discovery, defined technical scope, aligned stakeholders, and translated business requirements into API specs and integration tasks. Coordinated cross-functionally with R&D and Product, managed backlog items, validated data flows (SQL/Postman), and oversaw QA through go-live and post-launch optimization.
caseStudies.outcome: Enabled stable high-volume RTB operations and partner connectivity, reducing manual intervention and accelerating time-to-production. Scaled the same framework to additional mid-market clients (~$20K/month each).
